runSummary.stalePolicy: Discovery age is not verification age. LIVE requires fresh full-detail/link evidence; list/search resurfacing cannot set verifiedAt.
runSummary.note: Diversified locality-gated sweep covered Profesia, direct-company/public ATS, LinkedIn, Worki, Kariera, Praca za rohom, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, WordPress public ecosystem, Reddit/WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. LinkedIn exposed Wolt Support Associate Full Time Remote in Bratislava, but mandatory minimum B2 English plus shift work mornings/evenings/weekends and 1270 EUR base make it a weak profile fit, so it was not promoted. Upwork returned several concrete WooCommerce jobs, but the stronger-paying ones are older/high-competition or require expert/hard-development scope; no new item cleared the promotion bar. Facebook has 0 verified hits. Existing LIVE jobs remain fail-closed because jobs-data.json is truncated by the repository reader and complete round-trip replacement cannot be guaranteed.

developmentChanges.title: Application competition decay curve
developmentChanges.reason: Model proposal count together with post age and client last-view time instead of using proposal count alone, so a low-proposal stale post does not outrank a newer actively reviewed opportunity.

developmentChanges.title: Remote label trust check
developmentChanges.reason: Separate a job-board remote label from the actual work-mode text. Require the detail to confirm Slovakia-compatible remote work and record training/office attendance separately, preventing misleading remote classifications.
